settings_registry_workspaces_description: Where Atlas puts worktrees, how their branches are named, and cleaning up the ones you no longer use.
settings_registry_workspaces_ws_autoclea: Remove linked worktrees whose PR was merged or that sat idle, never with unsaved or unpushed work.
settings_registry_workspaces_ws_cleanup_: See size, last commit and git state of linked worktrees, and delete the ones you no longer need.
settings_registry_workspaces_ws_dir_desc: Where Atlas creates checkouts for new worktrees.
settings_registry_workspaces_ws_hygiene_: Processes Atlas or an agent left running after their owner died, the disk each project holds, and what Fix can free.
settings_registry_workspaces_ws_nest_des: Put each worktree in a folder named after its repository.
settings_registry_workspaces_ws_prefix_d: Added in front of the branch Atlas creates, so branches are easy to tell apart.
